explanation: Merged main (#30) into the expression-source reader branch. From this branch: sourceJson.test.ts covers the transport's family allow-list, version cache-bust, shared requests, forget-on-failure and reset; baselineTeaser.test.ts checks over the real reader that every teaser row equals the survey's group mean and that AgRP groups are not pooled; survey loader tests use resetSourceRequests/sourceJson and portal/gene-report fixtures use the groups shape. From main: explorerSession.test.tsx pins the analysis snapshot against the session's defaults.
